revision_note: v3: VAE licence corrected to Apache-2.0 (local flux2-vae_small is byte-identical to black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-small-decoder). The full-size decoder is non-commercial and parked. Qwen-Image-2.1, its LoRAs and Kijai-derived LoRAs are out of scope for distribution. Commercial use of the assembled pipeline is no longer blocked.
note: What actually ships, in what form, under which grant, with which files. `tools/license_audit.py` verifies the hashes. This file is the packing list; components.json is the legal registry. A layer here must reference component ids there.

excluded_from_distribution.reason: Qwen Research License Agreement, §2a non-commercial only. Local validation use only.
Inherit the base model's non-commercial terms; two local files have no identifiable upstream.

The Kijai-derived file has no licence grant upstream (cardData.license null), so it defaults to all-rights-reserved. Team-trained LoRAs are MIT but the component is excluded as a whole to avoid shipping the unlicensed file.

parked_noncommercial.why_parked: No Apache-2.0 release of the FULL decoder exists. FLUX.2-klein publishes only a DiT single-file with no separate VAE, so FLUX.2-small-decoder is the only Apache-2.0 decoder BFL ships.
parked_noncommercial.guard: Moved out of models/vae/ so ComfyUI's model scan cannot load it.

composite_licence.statement: MIT + Apache-2.0 + GPL-3.0. The effective terms for the assembled pipeline are the union of their obligations: MIT attribution, Apache-2.0 §4b/§4c notices, GPL-3.0 source availability for the node layer. No non-commercial term remains in the shipped pipeline.
composite_licence.effective_redistribution: allowed, provided every layer's notice obligations are met

corrections_recorded.what: VAE licence was reported as FLUX non-commercial.
corrections_recorded.why_wrong: The conclusion was inherited from the Comfy-Org/Flux-2-Dev repository-level tag without checking the file itself.
corrections_recorded.how_fixed: Hashed the local file and reverse-looked-up the digest. It matches black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-small-decoder/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors byte for byte, and that repo is Apache-2.0 with the grant stated in its README.
corrections_recorded.lesson: File-level provenance outranks a repackager's repo-level tag.
